identity.name: TokenSafe OUMV adapter for Spring Boot (JDK-only sidecar)
identity.description: Static Spring annotation scanner plus OUMV JSON-RPC over stdio and HTTP, launched with the JDK single-file source launcher. No Maven, Gradle or Spring jars.

limitations: routes are discovered statically from Spring annotations; no live router registration is consulted
parameters are read from @PathVariable/@RequestParam/@RequestBody annotations; no DTO reflection without a Spring context
L0-L3 only; L4 request traces are not implemented and not advertised because the sidecar never runs the application
static reverse-dependency scan; observe=false and provenance=static, never runtime evidence
OCC expectedVersion is mandatory; stale tokens fail with -32001
syntax pre-flight is a structural brace/paren/bracket and string/comment check, not a full Java parser
runs a configured compile/test command (default `javac {file}`); the status is the real exit code
no runtime dispatch: the sidecar does not start the Spring application, and scope.notExecuted says so
